description: NaCaVO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and four longer (2.47 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 73-79°. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.38 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-52°. There are two shorter (1.74 Å) and two longer (1.75 Å) V-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂CaV tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one V atom.
